request.state: Two established producers reach the same typed message sink: source constructors return exact native scalar objects, and storage/query presentation scopes return validated scalar strings. Native source messages currently refuse; wire-backed messages render. Canonical argument type ids are retained and the shared descriptor value slot is unknown. The presentation package presently depends on shared contracts rather than the native-values package; native-values already exports type guards and strict canonical codecs, with instant range validation in the codec. Complete the required presentation workflow without losing valid wire consumers, exact values, legal source evaluation/default/failure order, or render-stage validation. New dependency cost and upstream adapter/type-association cost must both be counted. Do not add provenance heuristics, permissive type coercion, early descriptor serialization, or claim that this settles the separate trusted locale/timezone context join.

message_boundary.instructions: Choose the most reliable minimal full producer-to-presentation join. Consider total dependency and adapter costs while preserving every required existing and native workflow.

criteria.uniform_upstream: Make native scalar values uniform before evaluating language expressions by hydrating declaration-associated model/query/result inputs through typed adapters. Preserve public wire persistence/query APIs, then convert native message arguments to the existing UI representation only after complete source/default evaluation. This avoids changing UI native acceptance, with the full upstream closure and validation timing required.
criteria.presentation_join: Join both legitimate carriers at the existing presentation scalar sink: existing wire input validation stays, and proven native inputs use public guards plus the owning strict codec. Preserve typed native descriptors until rendering. Add UI-to-values dependency with exact malformed/range/evaluation/formatting checks; retain wire producers and independent context/locale requirements.
